variant.changelog:
Version 20.0.0.11

- Fixed Ragworm sometimes not getting bought if you were standing near an aetheryte.
- Plugins which are turned off while running now will re-enable 30 seconds after it stops.
- Fish and hunt data now come with the plugin, no more downloading.
- Moon missions got a lot of love:
    - Fixed the fish lists in 118 missions, which had the wrong fish or were missing one
    - Uses lures, Surface Slap and Identical Cast where they actually help
    - Knows the right bait and mooch chain for each fish
    - Throws back bites it doesn't need and picks Double or Triple Hook based on what's probably biting
    - Goes after intuition fish faster, and more often in score missions
- New setting, "Reel in late casts": if nothing bites in time, it reels in and tries again.
- New setting, "Save a chain fish for when the target can bite": it keeps a fish with Spareful Hand and fishes with it the moment the big one can bite.
- The cordial setting is now just "Never", "Smart" or "When low on GP".

variant.changelog:
Added
  - Leveling mode
  - 6 missing moon missions

  Improved
  - Mooches
  - Big intuition fish
  - Predators are caught faster with Identical Cast and multi-hooks
  - Surface Slap on big fish
  - Banking stacks while waiting for a window
  - GP use, especially around Patience
  - Moon missions with limited bait
  - Ocean mission multi-hooks
  - Status text and log

  Fixed
  - Getting stuck when a spot dries up or the game says there are no fish
  - Facing the water properly
  - Endless retrying when out of bait
  - Wasted Makeshift Bait when a mooched fish got away
  - Reeling in early while intuition is up
  - Putting the rod away when switching fish at the same hole
  - Identical Cast not working on moon missions
  - Bait swap spam at the end of a voyage stop
  - Voyage report not counting Identical Casts
  - Wrong hookset shown for some fish

  Changed
  - "Reel in late casts" and "Save a chain fish" are always on now

variant.changelog:
• New overlay fish and bait icons, a phase badge, a big countdown, and the plan as steps
• New idle overlay
• IPC lets other plugins run their own tasks while Feesh waits between fish
• Tours set a fish aside after 40 casts with no progress
• Tours buy bait straight away when a fish runs out
• Casts that land in the wrong hole move to another stand
• Travel gives up after circling a hole for two minutes
• Gets out of the water when swimming
• Stops the tour when the bags stay full
• Fishing spots under an overhang lands nearby and walks in instead of flying up and down
• Turns to find the water before giving up on a stand, and remembers the facing that worked
• Slap fish for 77 more fish, and helper lures for 11 fish
• Slippery fish are marked on the overlay
• Minimum Gathering check before fishing
• Plans GP and Cordials for the last predator and the window
• Saves GP for Patience II by skipping Chum before a window
• Prize Catch when saving a rare swimbait fish
• Intuition no longer comes up early from a Double Hook
• Fixed getting stuck when the game refused Chum with "no fish here"
• Makeshift Bait works on mooch chains again
• Better spot picking at the boat railing
• Says when the saddlebag has the bait you're out of
• Removed the bite time let go setting

variant.author: wah
variant.changelog:
- Added catch jobs: other plugins can tell Feesh which fish to catch and how many
- While a plugin is running a catch job, Feesh is locked and shows which plugin is using it
- Catch jobs can protect their fish from desynth, discard and scrip turn-ins
- You can set a catch count for fish on My list
- Tours no longer jump every 10 minutes while waiting
- Surface Slap now picks a fish your lure doesn't already reduce, so the slap isn't wasted
- If time is short before a fish's window, Surface Slap uses any suitable fish
- Chum can now be used below 500 GP during a big fish's window
- Fixed the fish table's gap at the bottom and the last fish being out of reach
- Fish page filters update faster
- Click a bait name to copy it
- Fixed scrip picking Heirloom Goldgrouper instead of Goldgrouper

variant.author: wah
variant.changelog:
### Fish
- Tour panel now shows **Now**, **Next Up**, and **Leave At**.
- Tours reserve time for the next fish and only catch what fits before departure.
- **Tasks → GC** catches and turns in the daily Grand Company Provisioning mission.
- Tours replenish low-stock bait during bait runs.
- Bait quantities below 50 are restocked before departure.
- Single fish now respect the wait limit, including Intuition fish.
- Surface Slap is removed when Intuition expires and the target fish is needed again.
- Improved GP management during Intuition preparation and short Intuition windows.
- Added count boxes to Fish and Hunter rows, tracking only new catches.

### Bait
- Added new vendors:
  - Synnove
  - Mare Lamentorum Junkmonger
  - Denys (requires the **Mislaid Plans** quest)

### Ocean
- Catches made during the final 30 seconds of a stop now count.

### Ocean Achievements (Mantas, Shrimp, Mantis)
- Identical Cast is preserved for completing achievement goals.
- **Mantas:** Third stops can now trigger Spectral Currents.
- **Shrimp:** Prioritizes shrimp instead of chasing the Sirensong Spectral Current.
- Stops without target fish now build Angler's Art for the next stop.
